## v1.0.6 product boundary

The current product source and release documentation establish these facts:

- `agentsight bind` is an opt-in, unprivileged Direct Node entry point and does not replace `top`, `record`, `report`, or `monitor`;
- it defaults to a loopback API on `127.0.0.1:7395` and stays alive while the command is running;
- the binding link carries a random process-lifetime access key in the URL fragment, and the hosted SPA removes that fragment after opening;
- `--db` can select a saved capture; otherwise the command can use the latest matching local capture or local agent-session index;
- `--listen`, `--server-port`, `--endpoint`, and `--app-url` support explicit network/self-hosted presentation choices;
- detailed session data remains on the Node in Direct mode; optional hosted sign-in/control-plane state is limited to identity, session, and Node metadata;
- this release does not establish managed relay, organization RBAC/capabilities, browser proof-of-possession, Site Gateway, or a full enterprise lifecycle.

The website must not broaden those statements beyond the released implementation.
